title: Grateful Dead Live at San Jose State University on 1969-10-31
lineage: SBD > MC > C1> DAT> CDR > SHN

ai_review.summary: Rare Halloween‑1969 show with the one‑off Cryptical Suite → China Cat Sunflower segue, but captured on a raw, hiss‑filled recording.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its solid set – standout moments include a tight Dire Wolf, an inspiring Cryptical Suite that segues into China Cat Sunflower (the only time this combo was played) and the usual Dead energy.  Unfortunately the source suffers from heavy hiss and low fidelity, making it a raw listening experience that would benefit from audio cleanup.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers consistently note strong musical moments (unique segue, solid songs) but also flag severe hiss and poor recording quality; the average star rating is 3.25, leading to a moderate overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Heavy hiss throughout, muffled instruments, raw and low‑fidelity capture; reviewers suggest the tape needs cleaning or restoration.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A solid, energetic set highlighted by the unique Cryptical‑to‑China Cat transition; overall pacing praised despite the raw recording.
